tooltip.swiftskyblock.hammer.line1: Crushes Cobble -> Gravel -> Sand -> Dust (Netherrack -> Soul Sand).
tooltip.swiftskyblock.hammer.line2: Sneak + mine to vein-crush! Crushes Compressed blocks 9x at once!
tooltip.swiftskyblock.magnet.desc: Pulls nearby items and XP orbs so nothing falls into the void.
tooltip.swiftskyblock.pocket_watch.line1: Right-click a machine or crop to fast-forward 100 ticks!
tooltip.swiftskyblock.pocket_watch.line2: Eliminate waiting on furnaces, crucibles, barrels, and farms.
tooltip.swiftskyblock.guide.desc: Right-click to view the Swift Skyblock progression & shortcut guide.
tooltip.swiftskyblock.dust_block: Sift in a Rapid Sieve for Redstone, Glowstone, Blaze Powder & more.
tooltip.swiftskyblock.compressed_block: 9 blocks compressed. Crush with a Hammer or sift for 9x instant output!
tooltip.swiftskyblock.double_compressed_: 81 cobblestones compressed. Crush with a Hammer for 9x Compressed Gravel!
tooltip.swiftskyblock.rapid_sieve: Right-click to sift 8 blocks instantly (Sneak: full stack!). Hopper compatible.
tooltip.swiftskyblock.compost_barrel: Composts organics into Dirt in 2s! Also makes Clay, Obsidian, Netherrack, Soul Sand & End Stone.
tooltip.swiftskyblock.cobble_gen_tier1: Generates 2 Cobblestone/s. Pushes to chest above. Right-click: stack, Sneak: compressed.
tooltip.swiftskyblock.cobble_gen_tier2: Generates 8 Cobblestone/s. Pushes to chest above. Right-click: stack, Sneak: compressed.
tooltip.swiftskyblock.cobble_gen_tier3: Generates 32 Cobblestone/s. Pushes to chest above. Right-click: stack, Sneak: compressed.
tooltip.swiftskyblock.turbo_furnace: Smelts 8x faster than a normal furnace with 2x fuel efficiency!
tooltip.swiftskyblock.rapid_crucible: Place over a heat source (Torch/Magma/Lava) and feed Cobble for rapid Lava!
tooltip.swiftskyblock.acceleration_lante: Accelerates nearby machines, furnaces, hoppers & crops to 4x speed!
message.swiftskyblock.welcome_tip: Tip: Sneak repeatedly to grow trees fast! Right-click the Guide in the chest or run /sb guide.

guide.swiftskyblock.step1: 1. Fast Trees & Crops: Sneak repeatedly near saplings/crops to grow them in seconds! Hold Sneak while chopping logs to vein-mine whole trees.
guide.swiftskyblock.step2: 2. Hammer & Rapid Sieve: Sneak+Right-click dirt empty-handed for Pebbles -> Cobble. Crush Cobble->Gravel->Sand->Dust with a Hammer, then Sneak+Right-click a Rapid Sieve to sift a full stack at once!
guide.swiftskyblock.step3: 3. Rapid Compost Barrel: Compost leaves/saplings into Dirt in 2s. Mix Water+Dust=Clay, Lava+Dust=Netherrack, Lava+Sand=Soul Sand, Lava+Glowstone=End Stone.
guide.swiftskyblock.step4: 4. Automation & Speed: Craft Auto Cobblestone Generators (Tier 1-3), Rapid Crucible (fast Lava), Turbo Furnace (8x smelting), Acceleration Lantern (4x area speed), and Time Pocket Watch!
guide.swiftskyblock.step5: 5. Safety: Sky Magnet prevents item drops into the void, and Void Safety rescues you if you fall!
